sources_used: levelone.nl / lakes leisure (NL FEC site + arcade-games page)
web search (MX PIU popularity; NL/NZ/Mongolia rhythm locations)

findings.name: Cinépolis Paseo Monclova
findings.evidence_quote: Games list only Claw Machine x3 (Mini Gool, Muñelocos). No music/rhythm cabinets.
findings.note: Cinema foyer claw-only stub. Positive inventory: claws only.

findings.name: Circus Park (Circus Circus) - Sun Mall
findings.evidence_quote: Games: No games at this location. Updated 2020-03-15.
findings.note: Monterrey-area FEC chain. ZIv empty; no independent machine list found. Family park type often has generic cabs, not Bemani.

findings.name: Circus Park - Esfera Fashion Hall
findings.evidence_quote: Games: No games at this location. Updated 2020-03-15.
findings.note: Same Circus Park chain as Sun Mall. No public cab inventory.

findings.name: Diversiónes Imagínate - Macroplaza
findings.evidence_quote: Games: No games at this location. Updated 2019-11-18.
findings.note: Mexicali family entertainment. Empty ZIv; no web machine list found.

findings.name: Diversiónes Imagínate - Nuevo Mexicali
findings.evidence_quote: Shard notes empty; sister Macroplaza location also has no ZIv games.
findings.note: Same Imagínate chain. No machine inventory online.

findings.name: Fiesta Park
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (International) x2, 2 Tokens/2 Fichas, Perfect.
findings.note: Only music-class cab is Guitar Hero Arcade (not a valid named slug; mapped to other). No DDR/PIU/maimai/Bemani on long 2023 inventory.

findings.name: HappyLand Park - Plaza Las Misiones
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (International) MX$10.95 Perfect. Also King of Route 66, Transformers (Not Working), Batman.
findings.note: 2018 ZIv visit. Guitar Hero Arcade -> other. Stale; current lineup unverified.

findings.name: Magic Bowl
findings.evidence_quote: English: The only Bowling alley at Monclova with 2 air hockey tables and 2 Xbox 360 Multigames. Games: Hockey Table x2 only.
findings.note: Owner/submitter description is positive inventory: bowling + 2 air hockey + 2 Xbox multigames. No arcade rhythm cabs.

findings.name: Mundo Divertido
findings.evidence_quote: Games: No games at this location. Updated 2019-11-18. Large Tijuana family park with arcade section per tourism writeups.
findings.note: Large FEC; empty ZIv does not equal no games. No named Bemani/PIU evidence found for this branch.

findings.name: Peter Piper Pizza - Plaza Bella Anahuac
findings.evidence_quote: Games: No games at this location. Created/updated 2022-03-15.
findings.note: Pizza-restaurant kids arcade chain. Typical redemption mix; no branch-specific rhythm evidence.

findings.name: Peter Piper Pizza - Plaza Fiesta San Agustín
findings.evidence_quote: Shard lists no notes; same Peter Piper Pizza MX chain as z6203 with empty ZIv pattern.
findings.note: No public cab list for this San Pedro Garza García branch.

findings.name: Smash
findings.evidence_quote: Games: No games at this location. Info: Located on the 2nd floor, on the left side, to the bottom.
findings.note: Puebla mall arcade stub with floor note only. Nothing findable on games.

findings.name: ¡Recórcholis! - Plaza Galerías Saltillo
findings.evidence_quote: Partial 2018 list only: ATV Track, Super Bikes (2P), Jurassic Park Arcade (2015), Terminator Salvation. No music games on partial list.
findings.note: Recórcholis is a large national FEC; 4-cab ZIv sample is incomplete. Chain site promotes attractions/redemption, not Bemani. Cannot confirm none.

findings.name: "Catch Me" Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Dance Central 3 (International) ₮2000 / 3 songs, Great. Updated 2026-01-04.
findings.note: Kinect Dance Central 3 is a music/dance cab but not a valid named slug; mapped to other. Dragon Bus Terminal UB.

findings.name: Gegeenten Entertainment Center
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Sweet Honey Bee, L.A. Machineguns, Let's Go Jungle, House of the Dead 4, ENSHOOT (2 cabs). No music/rhythm titles. Updated 2025-04-30.
findings.note: 2025 visitor-maintained shooter/redemption inventory. No rhythm cabs listed.

findings.name: Mars Playland (Soyolj Mall)
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: 舞战纪 (Dance Battle) and 舞立方·秀 (DANCE³·Show), both China, 2 coins/3 songs, Perfect. Note: The two rhythm games there are offline.
findings.note: Chinese pad/dance clones (Dance Battle, DANCE3 Show), not official PIU/DDR/maimai. Mapped to other. Photos on ZIv.

findings.name: Shangri-La Urgoo 3 iMAX Game Center
findings.evidence_quote: Games: OutRun 2 (2 cabs), Overtake DX, Dark Escape 3D, Deadstorm Pirates, HOTD4, Transformers HA, Sweet Land 4, Basketball x2, Power Hockey. No music games. Updated 2025-06-06.
findings.note: Cinema-attached game center. Racing/shooter/redemption only on 2025 list.

findings.name: Soyolj Mousehouse
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: 舞战纪 (Dance Battle) (China), Great. Plus fighters/racers/shooters. Updated 2025-06-08.
findings.note: Chinese Dance Battle only as music class. Mapped to other.

findings.name: Spaceland
findings.evidence_quote: Games: No games at this location. Created 2026-01-04 same address as Catch Me (Dragon Bus Terminal).
findings.note: Empty ZIv stub next to Catch Me. No lineup findable.

findings.name: Urgoo Cinema
findings.evidence_quote: Games: No games at this location. Website urgoo.mn. Updated 2025-09-21.
findings.note: Cinema entry; may be mis-tagged vs Urgoo game centers. No cab list.

findings.name: Urgoo Park Od
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Dark Escape 3D, Razing Storm, Transformers HA, ENSHOOT (2 cabs), Power Hockey. No music games. Updated 2025-06-06.
findings.note: Park Od Mall 5F Urgoo. Shooter/table inventory only.

findings.name: Гайхамшигтай Ертөнц (Zaisan Hill)
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Audition Online; E-Dance Fame (China); 美拍小鼓王 / Little Drummer (China); 舞立方 (DANCE³) (China). Photos of 舞立方 2025-03-22.
findings.note: Chinese/Korean dance and Audition-style music cabs, not official Bemani/PIU/maimai. All map to other.

findings.name: Kidzo Arcade @ Menara Mall
findings.evidence_quote: This arcade has like a weird rhythm game called Super V-drums which is a similar to what drummania (gitadora) is. ... look at 01:18 on this video to see this rhythm game (even though it's off).
findings.note: Super V-drums is NOT official GITADORA/DrumMania; do not use gitadora slug. Mapped to other. 2021 note, current status unknown.

findings.name: Bonami SpelComputer Museum
findings.evidence_quote: Long free-play retro inventory (racers, shooters, fighters, classics). Pictures include thumbnail titled 'DDR cab' but DDR is not in the Games table.
findings.note: Museum. Photo title alone is insufficient to claim playable DDR. No modern Bemani on listed games. Ambiguous DDR photo vs missing list entry.

findings.name: Bowling Scheveningen
findings.evidence_quote: Bowling alley with a small arcade section. Games: Star Wars pinball, F355, GRID, Mario Kart GP2, Operation G.H.O.S.T., Barbercut, UFO Stomper, basketballs, Arctic, Big Wave. No music games.
findings.note: 2019 inventory only; no rhythm titles then. Stale for certainty.

findings.name: Bowlingcentrum Ol'Round
findings.evidence_quote: Info once mentioned Including a DDR X Cabinet. Comment by nela (~2025): DDR is long gone, OutRun 2 SP is the only reason to come here. Active games: OutRun 2, Mad Wave, Boxer.
findings.note: Positive recent visitor statement that DDR was removed. Remaining cabs non-rhythm.

findings.name: De Bierkantine Utrecht
findings.evidence_quote: Full 2023 list with photos: Ms. Pac-Man, pinballs, Manx TT, Sega Rally, HOTD3, Time Crisis II, Metal Slug, Virtua Tennis, hockey x2, PhotoPlay. No rhythm/music cabinets.
findings.note: Barcade with photographed inventory; no Bemani/PIU/DDR.

findings.name: De Voltage - Indoor Entertainment
findings.evidence_quote: 2016 list: Ms. Pac-Man/Galaga, Iron Man, Sega Rally 3, Catch The Light. Updated 2016-07-26. Described as biggest indoor entertainment center in NL with many activities.
findings.note: 10-year-old partial list at huge venue. Too stale for confirmed_none.

findings.name: Gamecity Zoetermeer
findings.evidence_quote: Comment by nebbii: Checked the place out, no more DDR sadly. Current games: Shrek pinball, Daytona Championship USA, shooters, basketballs, boxers, Lane Master, Big Wave. Updated 2026-05-13.
findings.note: Positive visitor note that DDR is gone; current listed lineup has no music games.

findings.name: Highscore Kijkduin
findings.evidence_quote: Site highlights King Kong VR, Flying Tickets, NBA Hoops. Instagram claims 50+ games. ZIv only lists Power Roll and NBA Hoops (2024-06-20).
findings.note: Family arcade FEC; incomplete inventories. No named rhythm evidence found.

findings.name: KiddieLand
findings.evidence_quote: Only has 1 arcade cab. The rest consist of mini rides for small children. Games: Mario Kart Arcade GP DX single cab only.
findings.note: Explicit single-cab kids area. No rhythm.

findings.name: Level One
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Pump It Up XX (International). History: 22 hrs ago giannistek1: Pump It Up XX (International) added. Roosendaal, Lakes Leisure Level One.
findings.note: Very fresh ZIv add (day before check). Site describes FEC mix (redemption/racing/VR) without naming PIU; rely on ZIv listing.

findings.name: Lucky Nugget
findings.evidence_quote: Slagharen theme park arcade. Partial list: Sno Cross, Jurassic Park Arcade Deluxe. Note: General coin pushers, basketball, etc. in the park.
findings.note: Partial ZIv sample inside theme park. Incomplete; no rhythm named.

findings.name: Sir Winston Fun & Games Scheveningen
findings.evidence_quote: Partial list 2021: Super Bikes 3, Halo Fireteam Raven 2P, NBA Hoops x3. Opened July 2021. No music games on partial list.
findings.note: Seaside FEC; ZIv likely incomplete. No positive rhythm evidence.

findings.name: Taurus world of adventure
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Minecraft Dungeons Arcade, Batman Dark Knight, Hot Wheels King Of The Road, MotoGP Arcade, Sega Rally 3. Note mentions air hockey and pinball. Updated 2026-05-09.
findings.note: Laser/bowling/arcade center. Recent list has no music games.

findings.name: Texel Aviation and War Museum
findings.evidence_quote: Museum with singular arcade cabinet. Games: Airline Pilots only (back of museum next to toilets).
findings.note: Explicit single non-rhythm simulator cab.

findings.name: TonTon Club Amsterdam
findings.evidence_quote: Current games: Simpsons, MKII, Virtua Fighter, Daytona, Mario Kart GP2 x2, SWDC, Crisis Zone, Rail Chase, T2, TC2, NBA Jam Extreme, Speed Soccer. Comments: pop'n confirmed gone; hard drive failed, cab removed (~8 years ago).
findings.note: Had pop'n historically; removed. Current barcade inventory has no rhythm/music cabs.

findings.name: Arcadia
findings.evidence_quote: Small old-timey arcade, has physical tickets and tokens. Games: No games at this location. FamilyAction: large variety spanning decades, claw/ticket focus.
findings.note: Blenheim NZ classic token arcade. No public machine list; unlikely modern Bemani but not proven.

findings.name: Bowlarama @ Palmerston North
findings.evidence_quote: One of few Bowlaramas in NZ with arcade games, all games are $2. Games: Injustice Arcade; Batman x2. No music games.
findings.note: Small bowling-alley cab set: fighters/action only.
